name: browser-recall
description: Chrome extension for tracking and searching browsing history

scripts.ci: npm run ci:test && npm run ci:install-playwright && npm run ci:test-extension-e2e && npm run ci:test-rust && npm run ci:install-desktop-visual-browsers && npm run ci:test-desktop-visual && npm run ci:cold-scripts && npm run ci:lint-js && npm run ci:lint-rust
scripts.ci:cold-scripts: npm run test:cold-scripts && npm run coverage
scripts.ci:lint-js: npm run fmt:check && npm run lint:unused && npm run lint:duplicates
scripts.ci:lint-rust: npm run build:desktop-ui && cargo fmt -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.build: npm run build:extension && npm run build --workspace @browser-recall/desktop
scripts.watch: node -e "console.log('No root watch step is required for the extension')"
scripts.dev: npm run build:extension && node -e "console.log('Load dist/extension/chrome in Chrome, or run npm run dev:desktop for the Tauri shell')"
scripts.test:visual: npm run build:desktop-ui && npm run test:visual:wkwebview && npm run test:visual:chromium && npm run test:visual:webkit
scripts.test:cold-scripts: cargo build --quiet -p browser-recall-daemon && playwright test tests/e2e/manual-seed-workflow.spec.js
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage:js && npm run coverage:rust && npm run coverage:monitor
